verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented 'Fivetran Alerts' feature, though only as a page title. The official MCP server can answer sync-status questions such as when a connection last completed a sync and whether any connections are broken, which implies run status is exposed. Missing for 10: per-sync logs, per-sync row counts, alert delivery via Slack/email/webhook, any detail on alert configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
